title: Just ok
text: Just ok. This rack is super super tiny and barely worth the counter space it takes up. You have to remove the tray to dump the water out. The silverware tray can go outside or inside the rack. I’m still on the fence as to whether I should use this or just use a towel for my hand wash dishes.
